panels.title: Deployment selection share
panels.description: Initial routing decisions, grouped by model and Gateway instance. Weights describe session buckets; unequal session traffic can skew request shares. No traffic produces no data.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, model, deployment_id) (rate(llm_gateway_routing_decision_total[$__rate_interval])) / ignoring (deployment_id) group_left sum by (job, instance, model) (rate(llm_gateway_routing_decision_total[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (job, instance, model, deployment_id, strategy) (rate(llm_gateway_routing_decision_total[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (job, instance, le, model, deployment_id) (rate(llm_gateway_ttft_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Mean output tokens/sec by deployment
panels.description: Mean of measured per-request output throughput. Missing timing or token usage remains missing.

targets.expr: sum by (job, instance, model, deployment_id) (rate(llm_gateway_output_tokens_per_second_sum[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job, instance, model, deployment_id) (rate(llm_gateway_output_tokens_per_second_count[$__rate_interval]))
